pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ryubing Canary is the fast-moving Canary channel of the Ryubing-maintained Ryujinx Nintendo Switch emulator.

use.flag: Install the desktop entry and application icon.
Prefer launching through games-util/gamemode when available.
Install MIME associations for Nintendo Switch content file types.
Enable the upstream in-app updater instead of forcing Portage-managed updates.
